title: The Bluewater Bunker
summary: On Saturday, March 7, 2015, after CPI Campus Police catch a private investigator hired by Aubrie Sinclair's law firm photographing Bennett Hall at the start of Spring Break, the Core Nine execute a tactical bug-out to Bob and Emily Scott's rural homestead—the Bluewater Bunker—where the Pact of Six pushes two beds together in the ground-floor sanctuary.
